name: Friends in Need
source: Friends in Need sees you stepping into the role of a man who made a very bad financial decision, which nearly resulted in your ruin. Years later, the reverberations of that decision echo once more through your life, suddenly enriching you beyond your wildest imaginings. When your best friend and long-time crush comes to you for help with her own financial misfortune, you realize that with nearly unlimited resources, you can be a force for good - or evil.
translation: 在《有需要的朋友》中，你扮演一个做出了非常糟糕的财务决定的人的角色，这几乎导致了你的毁灭。多年后，这个决定的影响再次回响在你的生活中，突然让你变得丰富起来，超出了你最疯狂的想象。当你最好的朋友和长期暗恋的人向你寻求帮助以解决自己的经济困境时，你意识到，凭借几乎无限的资源，你可以成为正义或邪恶的力量。
